prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Finalize Your Companion's Adoption", "Name your desktop pet and issue its certificate to complete setup."]
1: ["Sign In to Protect Your Desktop Companion", "Signing in ensures your pet state, memories, and custom visuals remain synced across sessions."]
2: ["Your Desktop Pet is Ready!", "Review the quick start checklist below to interact with and summon your pet anytime."]
3: ["Preparing Your Pet Desktop Workspace", "We are generating your desktop companion files and configuring background permissions."]
4: ["Choose Your Pet's Personality", "Select how playful or quiet your pet should be on your desktop.", "Personality Traits"]
5: ["Choose How You Want to Create Your Pet", "Select a ready-to-use pet or upload photos to generate a unique custom companion."]
6: ["Your pet customization and adoption progress will be linked directly to this account."]
7: ["Instant Pet Generation Guaranteed"]
8: ["Initializing local desktop renderer and setting up system tray shortcut..."]
9: ["Tip: Press your hotkey or right-click the system tray icon to hide or interact with your pet."]
